question: Does zero fallback after causal forward fill improve October campaign gain relative to leaving residual missing values or replacing them with training medians?
hypothesis_before_this_run: Zero may distinguish lack of recorded prior activity, but can also destroy informative absence and therefore may not improve on native missing handling or forward fill.

design.seeds: Same 30 values in upstream Exp1 config.json
design.test: Paired Wilcoxon across common seeds, Holm across these three planned comparisons separately for each metric; describes model randomness on one October cohort, not temporal generalization.

fallback_rules.FF_ZERO: Apply upstream causal forward fill by client to original features, then fill only residual nulls with numeric zero, before generating the same lags and deltas.
fallback_rules.mica_comparability: Aligned with inspected Mica E10 code at b4f92dc83ace1a068393c661ecf71c0e9e32d73a.
fallback_rules.FF_MEDIAN_MICA: Causal forward fill, then feature medians fitted on the forward-filled March-August training rows, then residual fill; follows Mica E10.

controls: Same upstream monthly zero-to-null audit and two excluded variables for all methods.
No target, client ID, month or partition field is imputed or used as a predictor.
Same original features and upstream row-based lags/deltas, same ordering.
September may provide feature history for October; November/December are used only for target construction and never as predictor history for earlier months.
All four methods rerun in the same local environment.
No parameters or variant choices are changed after seeing October results.

clarifications: Document's March-June train and August validation refer to historical model selection; final training follows corrected March-August repository.
Document says original zeros are retained, but published pipeline converts monthly all-zero columns to null; retain common published preparation and disclose this difference.
Zero fallback is not a validated business-rule imputation under H4.

additional_experiments: No new method for now. Describe how many residual missing cells/clients are affected and compare the existing four methods.

amendment.reason: User requested a shared median control with Mica.
amendment.timing: After inspecting October results; post hoc comparison.
amendment.published_results: Mica E10 published metrics; no local retraining claimed.
